accounts.title: Connected accounts
accounts.hint: Connect a Google Calendar or Outlook calendar. Events sync both ways; Google or Microsoft sends the invitations.
accounts.off: Once your admin switches on Google or Microsoft, you can connect your account here.
accounts.removeConfirm: Remove the calendars of {email} from Crewhall? Nothing is deleted at Google or Microsoft.
accounts.statusRevoked: Access was withdrawn. Connect the account again.
accounts.connected: Account connected. Its calendars appear in a few seconds.
accounts.busyOnlyHint: Titles, places, notes and people are not brought in; only the times you are busy show. Crewhall writes nothing to this calendar.

accounts.contactsAdmin: Contact sync needs an admin to grant the Contacts.ReadWrite permission.
accounts.contactsError: Contacts could not be synced. The calendar is not affected.

exchange.title: Connect Exchange account
exchange.hint: Sign in with your account on your organization's Exchange server. Your password is stored encrypted and is only sent to this server. If it changes, connect the account again.
exchange.usernameHint: Leave empty to use your e-mail address. If needed, write it as DOMAIN\user.

admin.title: Calendar connections
admin.hint: Enter your organization’s OAuth client so people can connect their Google Calendar or Microsoft 365 calendars to Crewhall.
admin.secretKept: The stored secret is kept. Type a new one to change it.
admin.tenantHint: Directory ID, organizations or common. Empty means common.
admin.redirectHint: Add this address to the app registration.
admin.accounts: {count, plural, one {# connected account} other {# connected accounts}}

google.title: Google Calendar
google.help: Google Cloud Console › APIs & Services: enable the Google Calendar API, then create an OAuth client of type “Web application” under Credentials.

microsoft.title: Microsoft 365 / Outlook
microsoft.help: Microsoft Entra › App registrations: create a registration, add a client secret under “Certificates & secrets” and the Microsoft Graph Calendars.ReadWrite permission under API permissions.

workspace.title: Google Workspace (organization-wide)
workspace.help: The service account works with domain-wide delegation granted by a Workspace admin. Create a service account in Google Cloud, grant its client ID these scopes in the Workspace admin console: {scopes}. Then upload its JSON key here.
workspace.adminHint: The directory is read on behalf of this Workspace admin.
workspace.directory: Sync the directory from Google Workspace
workspace.directoryHint: Title, department, team (cost center), phones, location and manager are read every hour. Synced fields become read-only in Crewhall.

domainWideHint.google: With domain-wide delegation granted to the service account, everyone's calendar syncs without anyone connecting. Needs the key below; scope: calendar.
domainWideHint.microsoft: With the application permission (Calendars.ReadWrite) consented by a Microsoft 365 admin, everyone's calendar syncs. Needs the tenant id; common does not work.

admin.contactsSyncHint: People's default Contacts folder syncs both ways and shows as private contacts. First add the Contacts.ReadWrite permission to the Entra app. People who connected earlier connect again.

exchange.title: Exchange (on-premises)
exchange.help: People sign in with their own Exchange account to connect their calendars. Exchange 2013 and later.
exchange.urlHint: The server's EWS address, over https. The Crewhall server must be able to reach it.
exchange.authHint: Exchange's default is NTLM. Basic only works if it is switched on at the server.
exchange.contactsHint: People's default Contacts folder syncs both ways and shows as private contacts.

booking.emptyAdmin: No resources yet. Add some in Admin › Rooms and desks.

booking.roomHint: Rooms go on one-off timed events only.
